items.quote: In the selfsame day entered Noah, and Shem, and Ham, and Japheth, the sons of Noah, and Noah's wife, and the three wives of his sons with them, into the ark
items.claim: Noah, his three sons, their wives, and Noah's wife entered the ark simultaneously
items.actor: Noah, Shem, Ham, Japheth, Noah's wife, and the three wives

items.quote: They, and every beast after his kind, and all the cattle after their kind, and every creeping thing that creepeth upon the earth after his kind, and every fowl after his kind, every bird of every sort.
items.claim: Every kind of animal—beasts, cattle, creeping things, and fowl—entered the ark
items.actor: every beast, all cattle, every creeping thing, every fowl, every bird
